response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong technical leadership and distributed-systems expertise across multiple domains, including event-driven architectures, microservices, and real-time systems. His recent work on AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq is promising, though direct production experience with multi-agent systems in fintech or regulated environments is limited. The resume lacks explicit evidence of scaling engineering teams to 30+ or designing AI-native fintech systems, which are critical for this role.
strengths: Strong distributed-systems and event-driven architecture experience (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby media)
Recent hands-on work with AI-agent frameworks and MCP (Model Context Protocol) at re:cinq
Proven track record in scaling engineering teams (e.g., RIDE Capital, Altom Consulting)
concerns: Limited direct fintech or credit-risk experience, a key requirement for the role
No explicit mention of operating multi-agent AI systems in high-stakes commercial environments
Scant evidence of designing governance frameworks for outsourced engineering or hybrid models
